title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 07:41:47 最新章节：第332章 九幽玄元
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
真玄又在真如寺的常委会上睡着了。
不对，是修炼，而且是在真寂眼皮子底下修炼。
实际上没人知道真玄已经开启了“神助”，更没有人知道真玄的“神助”是装逼。
真玄穿越来到这个高武世界已经三十年。
当初花了很长时间才接受这个同时拥有“妖”、“魔”、“鬼”、“怪”的危险世界。
后来才探索出这一方世界还有特殊的世界规则，叫做“神助”，佛家唤作“佛缘”。
天道至公，每个人生来便有一个“神助”对应的触发条件，满足条件触发了，天道便赐下修为或武学上的精进。
同时也会放大神助开启人的某种性格缺陷。
贪、嗔、痴、慢、疑，总得占一样。
触发条件越难，增幅越大。
所以一般越是常人难以做到之事，天道便越是慷慨。
真玄当年花了很久才摸清自己的佛缘是装逼。
这世上没有“装逼”这个词，更没有这个概念，是以天道将此判为极难开启的佛缘，每一次触发都慷慨得很。
十二岁那年，他爬上后山三十丈高的舍利塔塔尖，在狂风里打坐了一个时辰，下面围了几十个跟他差不多大的年轻弟子仰着脖子看，觉得他牛波一。
那次佛缘让他的修为从明劲初期跳到了明劲后期。
十四岁，他在澜沧府城擂台上，凭借着明劲圆满修为和一套炉火纯青的《真如七杀拳》硬刚一个暗劲中期的散修大半个时辰。
以吐了三口血的代价打断了对方的手臂骨，台下三千人鸦雀无声。
那次佛缘直接把他送进了暗劲期。
此后大大小小十几次，每一次都是精心算计。

天道给他的反馈，有时是修为精进，有时是武学突破，主打一个全凭老天爷的心意。
但每一次反馈之后，副作用也实打实地落下来。
他占的是“贪”和“痴”，“贪”的是“生”，执着于“活着”，恐惧失去生命，这是对“生”的强烈贪执。
“痴”是看不清生死无常的规律，执着于肉身是永恒的“我”，这是痴带来的执念。
随着对死亡的恐惧一次次被天道放大，所以他怕死，怕得要命。
怕到他能苟就苟，怕到每一次出手都必须一击必杀，怕到要在常委会上修炼。
当然最重要的是增长修为的同时还能装逼——
双赢，他真玄一个人要赢两次。
......
澜沧府真如寺，真如宝殿偏殿议事厅。
青石地面被岁月磨得油亮，檀香从铜炉中袅袅升起，与窗外的日光搅在一处。
厅中摆着一张九尺长的金刚石长桌，通体乌黑，坚硬至极。
据说是三代方丈澄通法师从极北寒渊带回的矿材，寺中两代匠僧耗费半年打磨而成。
莫说刀剑，便是化劲高手全力一击，也难在上头留下分毫痕迹。
如今百年过去，这张象征真如寺最高权力的石桌旁坐着方丈和十三位首座。
每月初一的常委会，风雨无阻。
真玄坐在长桌最末尾破妄禅院首座的席位上。
他双目微阖，双手结印置于膝上，呼吸绵长而均匀，周身气息内敛，仿佛浑然不觉身在何处。
看上去不过三十出头的年纪，面容白净，五官清秀，若不是穿着一身僧袍，倒更像个读书人。
真寂坐在方丈左手边第一席。

他腰背挺得笔直，面容粗犷，浓眉如戟，颧骨高耸，两颊横肉像是刀削出来的，整个人坐在那里便如同一尊铁塔。
常务副方丈兼任持戒堂首座，这个位置他坐了十二年，十二年来真如寺上下戒律森严，无人敢犯。
不对，也不能说是无人敢犯，末端那个让他恨得牙痒痒的家伙除外。
此刻他的脸色很不好看。
“第十七代弟子如明，于澜沧府城中饮酒、狎妓、斗殴，致使三名平民受伤，两名同门师弟轻伤。

Zhenxuan fell asleep again in the Standing Committee of Zhenru Temple.
No, it's cultivation, and it's cultivation under Zhenji's nose.
In fact, no one knows that Zhenxuan has activated "divine assistance", and no one knows that Zhenxuan's "divine assistance" is just a pretense.
It has been thirty years since Zhenxuan traveled through time and came to this world of high martial arts.
It took me a long time to accept this dangerous world with "demon", "devil", "ghost" and "weirdo" at the same time.
Later, it was discovered that this world has special world rules, called "divine assistance", and Buddhists call it "Buddha's fate".
The law of heaven is supreme. Everyone is born with a trigger condition corresponding to "divine assistance". If the conditions are met, the law of heaven will grant improvement in cultivation or martial arts.
At the same time, it will also amplify certain character flaws in the person that God helps to open up.
Greed, anger, ignorance, conceit, and doubt all have to be accounted for.
The more difficult the triggering condition, the greater the increase.
Therefore, generally the more difficult it is for ordinary people to do, the more generous Heaven will be.
It took Zhenxuan a long time to figure out that his relationship with Buddha was just a pretense.
There is no word "pretending" in this world, let alone this concept. Heaven has judged this as an extremely difficult Buddhist fate to open, and every trigger is very generous.
When he was twelve years old, he climbed to the top of the 30-foot-high stupa on the back mountain and meditated for an hour in the strong wind. Dozens of young disciples about his age gathered below and looked up, thinking that he was awesome.
That Buddhist fate caused his cultivation to jump from the early stage of Ming Jin to the late stage of Ming Jin.
At the age of fourteen, in the Lancang Fucheng Arena, he relied on Ming Jin's perfect cultivation and a superb set of "Zhenru Seven Killing Fist" to defeat a mid-level casual cultivator of An Jin for more than half an hour.
The opponent's arm bone was broken at the cost of vomiting three mouthfuls of blood, and the three thousand people in the audience fell silent.
That Buddhist fate directly sent him into the dark energy stage.
Since then, there have been more than a dozen times, big and small, each time with careful calculations.
The feedback Tiandao gave him was sometimes an improvement in his cultivation, sometimes a breakthrough in martial arts, and the main one was entirely up to God's will.
But after every feedback, the side effects are real.
What he accounts for is "greed" and "ignorance", and "greed" is "life". He is obsessed with "living" and is afraid of losing his life. This is a strong greed for "life".
"Insanity" means not being able to see the impermanent laws of life and death, and being obsessed with the eternal "I" that is the physical body. This is the obsession brought about by insanity.
As the fear of death was magnified by the law of heaven time and time again, he was afraid of death, so afraid that he would die.
He was so afraid that he could do whatever he could, so afraid that he had to kill with one hit every time he took action, so afraid that he had to practice in the Standing Committee.
Of course, the most important thing is to increase your cultivation and show off at the same time——
A win-win situation, he Zhenxuan wants to win twice by himself.
...
Lancang Mansion is really like the temple, and it is like the meeting hall of the side hall of the treasure palace.
The bluestone floor has been polished by time, and sandalwood curls up from the copper stove, mixing with the sunlight outside the window.
There is a nine-foot-long diamond table in the hall, which is completely black and extremely hard.
It is said that the third-generation abbot, Master Chengtong, brought back mineral materials from the cold abyss of the far north. Two generations of craftsmen and monks in the temple spent half a year polishing them.
Not to mention swords, even a full-strength strike from a master of energy conversion would be difficult to leave any trace on it.
Now a hundred years have passed, and the abbot and thirteen heads sit next to this stone table, which symbolizes the highest power of Zhenru Temple.
The Standing Committee meeting on the first day of every month is held rain or shine.
Zhenxuan sat at the end of the long table at the head seat of Powang Zen Temple.
His eyes were slightly closed, his hands were placed on his knees, his breathing was long and even, and his whole body's breath was restrained, as if he didn't even know where he was.
He looks to be in his early thirties, with a fair face and delicate features. If he weren't wearing a monk's robe, he would look more like a scholar.
Zhenji sat in the first seat on the left side of the abbot.
His back was straight, his face was rugged, his eyebrows were as thick as a halberd, his cheekbones were high, and the flesh on his cheeks seemed to have been cut with a knife. Sitting there, he looked like an iron tower.The executive deputy abbot also serves as the head of the precepts hall. He has held this position for twelve years. During these twelve years, the precepts in Zhenru Temple have been strict and no one dared to violate them.
No, it can't be said that no one dared to commit it, except for the guy at the end who made him hate it so much.
His face looked very ugly at the moment.
"The seventeenth generation disciple Ru Ming drank alcohol, had sex with prostitutes, and got into a fight in the city of Lancang Mansion, resulting in injuries to three civilians and minor injuries to two fellow disciples.
